title: Tap graph node events from the blessed host executor
narrative: Fangore’s console needs live path lighting as a durable plan runs. They want the same short host wiring used for submit-once jobs — not a second hand-built executor — and still receive node start and end events for the active steps. Complements `fangore_host_kit_submit_once` and feeds console zoom stories such as `fangore_conversational_tool_loop`.[^june-hf05-insp]
implementation: `mechaharness.host_kit.host_graph_executor` accepts `event_log=`. `tapping_event_log` / `TappingEventLog` forward emits to a host callback while preserving query. Config hook `get_event_log` binds the tap on the blessed inject path (HF-05).
validation: Kind `host_kit_event_tap` → `_run_host_kit_event_tap`. Soft expects: run status ok; tapped event types include graph_node_start and graph_node_end. Unit: `tests/test_conversational_tool_loop.py` (tap used with tool-loop runner).
